{{Top|leg}}
The '''dola''' was a near-[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aruza/Legends|Aruza]]. It produced small flowers that were sensitive to touch. When disturbed, the dola's flowers withdrew into thin shoots; however, if tenderly coaxed out, the flowers could be harvested for the thick juice they exuded. The [[Aruzan/Legends|Aruzans]] then processed the juice into a fluid used as an [[Antibiotic/Legends|antibiotic]].
